import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    vis = [False] * p
    ans = 1
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not vis[i]:
            # iterative DFS along the functional graph
            cur = i
            while not vis[cur]:
                vis[cur] = True
                cur = (k * cur) % p
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    if k == 1:
        ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
